answer: Escrowed bonds plus a referral graph keep the economy a haven. Newcomers post a 300-credit bond, backed by a member co-slashed if they cheat. The public graph exposes an orchard of fakes as a star cluster, flagged before it earns. Peers may dispute a suspect for 50 credits; five jurors check it, and a fake loses its bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 300 = 30,000; one honest agent pays 300 once and keeps earnings behind the velvet rope.
